posts.name: Killswitch
posts.cooked:
After the recent Q&A with Christopher, we've been divulged some hints about the Matriarch. We know that if she ever got her own Hero deck, she will discard her former mantle of The Matriarch.
 

I wanted to dicuss possible names for our favorite Bird Lady. My thoughts were:

  • Talon
  • Avian
  • Blackwing
  • Masquerade


What do you think? Post thoughts or suggestions in this thread.

posts.name: PlatinumWarlock
posts.cooked:
I'm going to make a Bold Prediction (tm) right now:

The final Sentinels expansion will be, as many have predicted, a "final climactic battle" against the cosmic forces that have been underlying the whole series.

However, I'm calling it now:  the subtitle for the expansion will be something along the lines of "Redemption" or even "Absolution"...and all of the included heroes will actually be "reformed" villains from earlier in the series.  Most notably, I'd guess it's Baron Blade, The Matriarch, Proletariat, and perhaps someone like the recently revealed Infinitor.  

Time will tell!
